task_summary: Improve the real-car tuning interface, preserve received data, and measure browser rendering under matched synthetic input.

acceptance: Practical task-focused controls, correctly scaled parameter forms, no automatic hardware commands, complete recorded/exported data, responsive layout, measured browser comparison and existing-site publication.
completed: Added speed/vision/all views, named gain inputs, draft-safe readback, freeze-with-reception and log search.
Removed offscreen/background visual work, bounded battery SVG output, cached chart preparation and reduced repeated log formatting.
38 unit tests and 34 mock browser checks passed; same 21000 records retained at both widths.
Published original site with unchanged public audience and preserved replay data.

metrics.name: Native workers
metrics.basis: Performance, official-source research/review, baseline/browser preparation, and browser continuation after interruption.

metrics.name: External Opus calls
metrics.basis: Project database handoff only; no acceptance reply claimed.

metrics.name: Interruption duration
metrics.basis: A user-side interruption stopped workers/services; total wall interval includes it.

metrics.name: Review/coordination overhead
metrics.basis: Interleaved with tests/publication; archive receipt records subsequent archive interval.

metrics.name: After browser performance run
metrics.basis: Browser report timestamps; same two viewport workloads.

metrics.name: Final browser interactions
metrics.basis: 34 checks, after two test-only timing/locator corrections.

metrics.name: Interaction executions
metrics.basis: Two failing test assertions were corrected; no product code changed between these runs.

observations: Official Serial Studio and PlotJuggler workflows informed task-focused controls; installed Playwright and native browser observers sufficed. Plugin discovery found no specific missing capability worth adding.
Independent review caught camera/PID selector collision and draft-status inconsistency; both fixed and covered in browser checks before publication.

Full synthetic browser comparison while watching curves: desktop long tasks 9 to 0, narrow viewport 25 to 0; same input and record totals. These are product measurements, not a matched multi-agent workflow baseline.
Chart microbenchmark improved static hover/statistics but slightly slowed changing-window preparation (0.598 to 0.656ms); do not claim a universal speedup.
Initial browser baseline was extended to include actually watching curves; first top-only result retained separately.
Connection-refused runs produced no valid samples. Existing service was restored using the project launcher, local backups and migration plan.
Interaction reruns corrected test timing/locator assumptions for throttled offscreen logs, not product defects.
No matched single-agent workflow baseline or provider usage; net coordination efficiency is unknown.

recommendations.action: Collect top-of-page and visible-chart workloads plus recording/export integrity in the initial browser plan; use condition waits for throttled UI.
recommendations.next_check: Next dashboard change reuses fixed synthetic inputs and verifies equal retained data before reporting rendering improvement.

evidence: evidence.json; source hashes, local browser reports/screenshots, unit logs, build and publication receipts.
limits: One machine and one matched rendering pair; no generalized performance claim.
No physical serial throughput measurement, flashing or motor action.
No cloud-browser or chart-library dependency added.
Local database backups remain local and excluded from publication/archive.
